instruction: Remove the laptop and the pastry plate at right; center the tray and cup, and nudge the headline down slightly to maintain balance with the empty tabletop.
Recolor globally: switch background to warm cream (#FFF3E6), change all pink typography to deep forest green (#0F3D2E), and apply a subtle warm filter to the car for cohesion.
Recolor the yellow “Last seen…” banner to black with white text.
Add a centered subtitle below 'PREMIUM PRODUCT' reading 'Naturally formulated for all skin types.' in sans-serif Medium, 12pt, #7A7A7A, +10 tracking, 12px top margin.
Brighten the "ART SPACE" pink by 25% and add a subtle 1px white drop shadow at 30% opacity to improve legibility against the navy background without changing composition.
Remove the top-right “Food” text; center “Larana Food” at the top and slightly increase its tracking to maintain balance.
Flip the background image horizontally and move the headline block to the right side, swapping positions with the coffee/laptop area for left-right balance.
Add a centered subtitle 'LIVE MUSIC • POP-UPS • GIVEAWAYS' in uppercase, 18pt semi-bold, orange (#FF5A2A), with +50 tracking, positioned 40px above 'OCTOBER 24' to balance spacing.
Make the cocktail illustration the main focal point by enlarging it 30%, raising contrast, and reducing “DAIQUIRI” size and saturation 40%.
Replace the black background with a deep midnight-blue to charcoal gradient with subtle grain, preserving high contrast for white lettering and the orange flower.
